sourceTitle: Sweet Potato Toast with Almond Butter
sourceText:
Sweet Potato Toast with Almond Butter
By: Nikki Brown
Published: Saturday, September 23, 2017 - 1:51pm

Ingredients




1 slice of sweet potato
2 tsp. almond butter

Preparation

1 Put the sweet potato in the toaster (or under the grill) until it has cooked through. 2 Spread with the almond butter, then serve.

About

This recipe is super, super simple and really delicious. Almond butter can be pretty expensive to buy, so we usually make our own, as it’s such a simple recipe. You can find it here http://www.mynutricounter.com/recipe-almond-butter/, if you’d like to give it a try too.
